help.title: Help
about.desc: Text Replacer finds and replaces text in many files at once — plain text, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, LibreOffice and RTF documents — and keeps the formatting.
start.1: Choose a folder: type its path, press Browse, or drop the folder into the window.
start.2: Set the file name mask, for example *.txt;*.docx. A single * means all files.
start.3: Type the text to find and the replacement. Several lines are allowed.
start.4: To make several replacements at once, add each pair to the list with “Add to list”, or load rules from a file.
start.5: Press Preview to see what would change — nothing is modified yet.
start.6: Press Replace. Keep .bak backups switched on if you want to be able to go back.
formats.1: Text files of any kind: UTF-8, UTF-16 and Windows-1251 are detected automatically.
formats.2: Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx) and LibreOffice / OpenOffice (.odt, .ods, .odp): the formatting is kept.
formats.3: RTF: edited in place, the formatting is kept.
formats.4: PDF (experimental): only Latin text in simple fonts is found; new characters may be missing from the embedded font.
formats.5: Old binary files (.doc, .xls, .ppt) are not supported: open them in Word or LibreOffice and save as .docx / .xlsx / .pptx first.
formats.6: In documents a match must lie inside one paragraph (in spreadsheets — inside one cell). Formulas, comments and charts are not changed.
formats.7: Tip: run Preview first, and keep .bak backups on for important files.
recipes.intro: Ready-made regular expressions. Press “Use” to fill in the fields and switch regular expressions on, then adapt them to your case.
recipes.note: In the replacement, $1, $2… are the parenthesised groups. Write ${1} when a letter or digit follows the group.

recipe.trailing.desc: Deletes spaces and tabs at the end of every line.

recipe.empty_lines.desc: Deletes lines that are empty or contain only spaces.

recipe.html.title: Remove HTML tags
recipe.quotes.title: Straight quotes → « » quotes
recipe.domain.title: Change a domain in links
recipe.domain.desc: Replaces http(s)://old.example.com with https://new.example.com. Edit the domains to suit you.
recipe.phone.title: Phone 555-123-4567 → (555) 123-4567

recipe.parens.desc: Deletes “(…)” together with the space before it.
